reviews.author: Peter Makris
reviews.text: We ended up having a leak in our air conditioner from the drain pipe in our attic. There were several spots where the drywall had to be completely taken out and replaced and then the knockdown texture reapplied. This is not something that's easy to replicate, and John did a fantastic job. It looks like the leak never happened. He even came back and did some touch up after the fact, really stands by his work. He's honest and transparent, pricing is comparable to other handymen, but the work is excellent. Also a nice and friendly guy.
reviews.source: Google, via Birdeye (reviews.birdeye.com/jacksonville-handyman-llc-156203781769223), fetched directly and parsed verbatim from the page's own review markup, 5 stars, posted 2 years ago. The full text is longer than the short version given in the task brief ('John did a fantastic job. It looks like the leak never happened. He even came back and did some touch up after the fact.'); this is the complete verbatim quote confirming and expanding the brief.

reviews.author: Erin Mongoven
reviews.text: John and Guillermo made it an incredible experience. John was prompt in his response and set expectations early on, not to mention the most affordable of competitors in the area. Guillermo arrived on time and finished services quickly and his quality of work was amazing!
reviews.source: Google, via Birdeye, fetched directly and parsed verbatim, 5 stars, posted 2 years ago. Matches and expands the task brief's shorter quote; also reveals a second worker name (Guillermo) alongside owner John Spassoff.

reviews.author: Michelle D
reviews.text: I've used John for all my home projects since purchasing my townhome is 2021. He's an honest man who shows up on time and does the job right. He installed a ceiling fan on my patio, replaced all the ceiling fans inside my home, painted nearly the whole house, including tricky stairs with a high ceiling. He installed my camera doorbell, keypad doorlock, and replaced my dining room light fixture. I'm sure I missed something, but you get the idea. If you're looking for a reliable handyman, look no further. I highly recommend John.
reviews.source: Google, via Birdeye, fetched directly and parsed verbatim, 5 stars, posted 2 years ago. Confirms and substantially expands the task brief's shorter quote; also gives concrete real service examples (ceiling fans, whole-house painting, camera doorbell, keypad lock, light fixture install) usable as service copy if the site had been built.

jacksonvillehandyman.com.result: HTTP 200, ~1MB of real content, a live Wix site titled 'Jacksonville Handyman'. IMPORTANT: this is a DIFFERENT, unrelated business.
